test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the left of Q. Only four people sit between Q and D. Only three people sit to the right of R. C sits to the immediate left of P. B is not an immediate neighbour of R. Who sits third to the left of B?
solution:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• No one sits to the left of Q.
 
• Only four people sit between Q and D.
 
• Only three people sit to the right of R.
 
• C sits to the immediate left of P.
 
• B is not an immediate neighbour of R

The Final Arrangement,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/899863ddcde0fb00f42d647a78c55e1a1c72618ebaa46659b19880dc3e40ab1a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
